# OEE data analysis

## setup

```{r}

options(rgl.useNULL = TRUE)
library(rgl)
```


## PCA

```{r}
# Apply PCA to whole tree, display clusters
# pca should be on independent vars?

pc <- prcomp(world[c("pgmDeath","maxEnergy", "speed", "kidEnergy", "nkids", "sensors", "matForKids")], #"sensors", 
             center = TRUE,
            scale. = TRUE)

library(ggfortify)
summary(pc)
autoplot(pc)
```

```{r}
# Plot principal components
plot(pc$x[,1])
plot(pc$x[,2])
plot(pc$x[,3])
```

```{r}
# Plot PC as tree
close3d()
plot3d(x= world$created, y=pc$x[,2], z = pc$x[,1], col = colors, main = folder)
rglwidget()
```

```{r}
# PCA over time!
t = min(world$created)
max_t = max(world$created)
step_size = 1000
pc1 = c()
pc2 = c()
pc_t <- data.frame(Ints=integer(), Doubles=double(), Doubles=double())
colnames(pc_t) = c("created", "pc1", "pc2")

while (t < max_t) {
  part_world = subset(world, (world$created>=t) & (world$created<t+step_size))
  pc <- prcomp(part_world[c("pgmDeath","maxEnergy", "speed", "kidEnergy", "nkids", "matForKids")], #"sensors", 
             center = TRUE,
            scale. = TRUE)
  
  temp_df = data.frame(part_world$created, pc$x[,1], pc$x[,2])
  colnames(temp_df) = c("created", "pc1", "pc2")
  pc_t = rbind(pc_t, temp_df)
  
  plot(pc$x[,1],pc$x[,2],main=t)
  
  t = t + step_size
} 
```

```{r}
# PCA on whole tree according to one time slice's projection
t = 4000
part_world = subset(world, (world$created>=t) & (world$created<t+step_size))
pc <- prcomp(part_world[c("pgmDeath","maxEnergy", "speed", "kidEnergy", "nkids", "matForKids")], #"sensors", 
           center = TRUE,
          scale. = TRUE)

projected = predict(pc, world[c("pgmDeath","maxEnergy", "speed", "kidEnergy", "nkids", "matForKids")])

plot(projected[,1])
plot(projected[,2])
plot(projected[,3])

```

## OEE Analysis

```{r}
folder = "2025_04_03_21_46"
realMapDeltasFile <- paste(base_folder, folder,"RealMapDeltas.csv",sep="/")
shadowMapDeltasFile <- paste(base_folder, folder,"ShadowMapDeltas.csv",sep="/")
```

### Step 1: Compute basic evolutionary activity statistics

```{r}

# COMPUTE A_cums


# Note: in this chunk and the next ones, a variable name that starts with "curr" indicate the current data, that is, the data at the current time stamp (which corresponds to a single CSV line)


deltas <- read.csv(realMapDeltasFile, stringsAsFactors=FALSE, header=TRUE, dec =".")


# the number of components
nbComponents <- ncol(deltas) - 1

# init current cumuls of deltas (intermediate values to compute a's from the deltas)
currCumuls <- rep(0, times=nbComponents)
# init current a's (i.e. cumulative evolutionary activities)
currAs <- array(dim = nbComponents)
# init A_cum's
Acums <- data.frame(
  t = integer(nrow(deltas)),
  Acum = integer(nrow(deltas))
)


# loop for computing A_cums
for (line in 1:nrow(deltas)) {
  # get time stamp
  t <- deltas[line, "t"]
  # get current deltas
  currDeltas <- as.numeric(deltas[line, 2:ncol(deltas)])
  # compute current cumuls
  currCumuls <- currCumuls + currDeltas
  # compute current a's
  for (i in 1:nbComponents)  {
    currAs[i] <- ifelse(currDeltas[i] == 1, currCumuls[i], 0)
  }
  # compute current A_cum
  currAcum <- sum(currAs)
  Acums[line,] <- c(t, currAcum)
}
```

```{r}
# DISPLAY A_cums

plot(Acums$t, Acums$Acum, type="l", col="blue", lwd=2,
     xlab="Time", ylab="A_cum", main="Evolution of total cumulative evolutionary activity")
grid()
```

### Step 2: Compute component-normalized evolutionary activity statistics

```{r}

# COMPUTE NORMALIZED A_cums AND MEDIANS (original formula and alternative formula)


realDeltas <- read.csv(realMapDeltasFile, stringsAsFactors=FALSE, header=TRUE, dec =".")
shadowDeltas <- read.csv(shadowMapDeltasFile, stringsAsFactors=FALSE, header=TRUE, dec =".")


# gather all components (i.e. those from the real model and those from the shadow model)
realComponents <- setdiff(names(realDeltas), "t") # (ignoring name "t" which is not a component)
shadowComponents <- setdiff(names(shadowDeltas), "t")
allComponents <- union(realComponents, shadowComponents)

# count number of components in the real model, then in total
nbRealComponents <- length(realComponents)
nbAllComponents <- length(allComponents)

# count number of lines
nbLines <- nrow(realDeltas) # NB: nrow(realDeltas) == nrow(shadowDeltas)

# Tells if a component currently exists in the real model
currRealDeltas <- as.data.frame(t(integer(nbAllComponents)))
colnames(currRealDeltas) <- allComponents
# init current normalized deltas
currNormDeltas <- as.data.frame(matrix(NA, ncol = length(allComponents), nrow = 1))
colnames(currNormDeltas) <- allComponents
# init current cumuls of normalized deltas
currNormCumuls <- as.data.frame(t(rep(0, times=nbAllComponents)))
colnames(currNormCumuls) <- allComponents
# init current normalized a's
currNormAs <- as.data.frame(t(integer(nbAllComponents)))
colnames(currNormAs) <- allComponents

# init normalized A_cums
normAcums <- data.frame(
  t = integer(nbLines),
  normAcum = integer(nbLines)
)
# init normalized medians
normMedians <- data.frame(
  t = integer(nbLines), 
  normMedian = integer(nbLines)
)

# init current alternative cumuls of normalized deltas
currAltNormCumuls <- as.data.frame(t(rep(0, times=nbRealComponents)))
colnames(currAltNormCumuls) <- realComponents
# init current alternative normalized a's
currAltNormAs <- as.data.frame(t(integer(nbRealComponents)))
colnames(currAltNormAs) <- realComponents

# init alternative normalized A_cums
altNormAcums <- data.frame(
  t = integer(nbLines),
  normAcum = integer(nbLines)
)
# init alternative normalized medians
altNormMedians <- data.frame(
  t = integer(nbLines),
  normMedian = integer(nbLines)
)


# loop for computing the A_cums and the medians
for (line in 1:nbLines) {
  
  
  # GET TIME STAMP
  t <- realDeltas[line, "t"]
  
  
  # COMPUTE CURRENT NORMALIZED A'S (REQUIRED TO COMPUTE NORMALIZED A_cums)
  # compute current normalized deltas
  for (comp in allComponents) {
    currRealDeltas[1, comp] <- ifelse(comp %in% realComponents, realDeltas[line, comp], 0)
    currShadowDelta <- ifelse(comp %in% shadowComponents, shadowDeltas[line, comp], 0)
    currNormDeltas[1, comp] = currRealDeltas[1, comp] - currShadowDelta
  }
  # compute current normalized cumuls
  currNormCumuls[1,] <- as.numeric(currNormCumuls) + as.numeric(currNormDeltas)
  # compute current normalized a's
  for (comp in allComponents) {
    currNormAs[1, comp] <- ifelse(currRealDeltas[1, comp] == 1, currNormCumuls[1, comp], 0)
  }

  # COMPUTE CURRENT ALTERNATIVE NORMALIZED A'S (REQUIRED TO COMPUTE ALTERNATIVE NORMALIZED A_cums)
  # compute current alternative normalized cumuls
  for (comp in realComponents) {
    if (currRealDeltas[1, comp] == 1) { # if component currently exists in the real model
      currAltNormCumuls[1, comp] <- currAltNormCumuls[1, comp] + currNormDeltas[1, comp]
    }
  }
  # compute current alternative normalized a's
  for (comp in realComponents) {
    currAltNormAs[1, comp] <- ifelse(currRealDeltas[1, comp] == 1, currAltNormCumuls[1, comp], 0)
  }

  # COMPUTE CURRENT NORMALIZED A_cum
  currNormAcum <- sum(currNormAs[1,])
  normAcums[line,] <- c(t, currNormAcum)

  # COMPUTE CURRENT NORMALIZED MEDIAN
  # filter out components that don't currently exist in the real model
  realActiveComps <- realComponents[realDeltas[line, realComponents] == 1]
  medianValues <- currNormAs[realActiveComps]
  # Compute current median
  currNormMedian <- ifelse(length(medianValues) > 0, median(as.numeric(medianValues[1,])), NA)
  # Save
  normMedians[line, ] <- c(t, currNormMedian)
  
  # COMPUTE CURRENT ALTERNATIVE NORMALIZED A_cum
  currAltNormAcum <- sum(currAltNormAs[1,])
  altNormAcums[line,] <- c(t, currAltNormAcum)
  
  # COMPUTE CURRENT ALTERNATIVE NORMALIZED MEDIAN
  # filter out components that don't currently exist in the real model
  altMedianValues <- currAltNormAs[realActiveComps]
  # Compute current alternative median
  currAltNormMedian <- ifelse(length(altMedianValues) > 0, median(as.numeric(altMedianValues[1,])), NA)
  # Save
  altNormMedians[line, ] <- c(t, currAltNormMedian)
  
  
  # TODO : compute A_news
  
}

```

```{r}

# DISPLAY NORMALIZED A_cums AND MEDIANS

# display A_cums
plot(normAcums$t, normAcums$normAcum, type="l", col="blue", lwd=2,
     xlab="Time", ylab="normalized A_cum", main="Evolution of adaptive total cumulative evolutionary activity")
grid()

# display medians
plot(normMedians$t, normMedians$normMedian, type="l", col="blue", lwd=2,
     xlab="Time", ylab="Median normalized A_cum", main="Evolution of adaptive median cumulative evolutionary activity")
grid()

# display A_new
# TODO



# DISPLAY ALTERNATIVE NORMALIZED A_cums AND MEDIANS

# display alternative A_cums
plot(altNormAcums$t, altNormAcums$normAcum, type="l", col="red", lwd=2,
     xlab="Time", ylab="Alternative normalized A_cum", main="Evolution of adaptive total cumulative evolutionary activity\r\n(alternative formula)")
grid()

# display alternative medians
plot(altNormMedians$t, altNormMedians$normMedian, type="l", col="red", lwd=2,
     xlab="Time", ylab="Alternative median normalized A_cum", main="Evolution of adaptive median cumulative evolutionary activity\r\n(alternative formula)")
grid()

```
